item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes DaemonSet Management: Best Practices and Tools
item.description: DaemonSets are a core Kubernetes workload type that ensures a copy of a Pod runs on all (or a subset of) nodes in a cluster. They are essential for node-level services: log collectors, monitoring agents, storage plugins, and network daemons that must run on every node. While the built-in Kubernetes DaemonSet controller handles basic scheduling, managing DaemonSets at scale requires careful planning around resource allocation, update strategies, node selection, and health monitoring.
